toegepas.voor: kan hy glad nie meer rek nie
toegepas.na: kan dit glad nie meer rek nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Here 'hy' means the shell, but two sentences later 'hy' means the crab; 'dit' makes clear that the shell can no longer stretch.
toegepas.fout: 'hy' could be read as the crab, which is 'hy' in the sentences right after it, so a reader may think the crab can no longer stretch
toegepas.rede_keurder: Using 'dit' ties the pronoun clearly to the shell, the meaning stays the same, and no protected wording is touched.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat 'n raam binne 'n ander dier doen
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat 'n raam binne-in 'n ander dier doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' is the form the lesson uses everywhere else for inside the body, and reads more naturally here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Binne 'n ander dier' is natural and pairs with 'buite in plaas van binne' in the next sentence; the swap is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'nou' reads as a time word (as if the strength moved); 'hier' means 'in this case', which is the intended contrast.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Contrastive 'nou' reads naturally, while 'hier buite' reads as the fixed phrase 'out here' and moves the sense.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: Dan word die nuwe dop hard
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Daardie dop' could point back to the old shell just mentioned; 'die nuwe dop' makes the reference clear and the word order is more natural.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Daardie dop' points to the new shell named in the sentence just before, and the proposal repeats 'nuwe' twice in one sentence.
